priorityList: Cast Immolation Aura before entering combat.
Use Reaver's Glaive if you do not have the Glaive Flurry or Rending Strike buffs and Essence Break is not active.
Use Death Sweep or Annihilation (or Chaos Strike if Meta is down) as a priority to consume the Rending Strike buff provided by Aldrachi Reaver.
Cast Metamorphosis if Eye Beam is on cooldown or Metamorphosis is about to expire, ideally after a Blade Dance.
Cast Essence Break while in Metamorphosis if Fury is above 35 and Blade Dance is available or will be soon.
Use Death Sweep (in Meta) or Blade Dance as your primary spender and top priority during Essence Break.
Use Eye Beam if Blade Dance is on cooldown and Essence Break is not active to trigger Demonic and generate Fury.
Use The Hunt if Essence Break is down and you do not have the Reaver's Glaive buff active.
Use Vengeful Retreat to trigger the Initiative or Inertia buffs, ideally right before using Eye Beam or entering a burst window.
Cast Fel Rush to consume the Inertia trigger if you are about to use a major cooldown like Eye Beam or The Hunt.
Use Immolation Aura to generate Fury, especially if you have two charges or need to prevent capping charges with A Fire Inside.
Use Felblade as your primary Fury generator if you are below 40 Fury or need to close the gap to the target.
Cast Annihilation (in Meta) or Chaos Strike to spend excess Fury or during the Essence Break window.
Use Throw Glaive as a low-priority filler if Soulscar is talented and other generators are on cooldown.
Use Arcane Torrent if Fury is below 35 and you have no other immediate generators available.
